name: Tenser's Floating Disk
description:
You conjure a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground, appearing within short range. Roll Lore to determine any additional effects.

The disk can hold up to 500 lbs. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls to the ground.

The disk is immobile while you are within short range of it. If you move further away, the disk follows you so that it remains within short range of you. It can move across uneven terrain, stairs, and slopes, but an elevation change of 10 feet or more causes the spell to end. The spell also ends if you are further than long range from the disk.
successes:
✨: The disk can hold an additional 100 lbs.

✨: The disk doubles in diameter.

🌞: You may spend an action to command the disk's to move up to 15 ft or command it to remain in one location until you command otherwise.

💀: The disk is unreliable. Check a Condition. Each time a new creature becomes the closest creature to the disk, roll a d8. On a 1, the spell ends. Otherwise, the disk becomes tethered to that creature and follows it as described above.
